subject: MAP: POC environment pathway — org bootstrap, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@cloudclinic.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudclinic.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment needs

Thanks Rachel — excited to get this moving. Per our call this morning, I want to capture the specific infra items we need from Redwood to hit the POC acceptance window (target close: 2027-05-14). Can you confirm the ownership split below?

CloudClinic ->:
- Provide list of CIDR blocks for our VPC peer and firewall team (we'll share by EOD Monday).
- Create service account if needed for the peering setup and provide admin contact.
- Validate inbound IPs once we have the Redwood ranges.

Redwood ->:
- Create MAP document with milestones for org bootstrap, API keys, and allowlist steps.
- Provision a test org for CloudClinic and issue one API key scoped to evaluation usage.
- Provide final VPC peering acceptance guide and expected downtime window (if any).

Attachments: CloudClinic-MAP-v1.xlsx (draft MAP with checkpoints)

Quick ask: can you provision the test org and API key by Wednesday 4/6? That will let our infra team start allowlist validation before the peering window.

— Alex
Engineering Lead, CloudClinic
[Attachment: CloudClinic-MAP-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@cloudclinic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment needs

Alex — thanks, this is clear and aligns with what we discussed. Confirming the split and calling out a couple of internal owners so nothing falls through:

Redwood owners:
- Org bootstrap & API key provisioning: Rachel Kim (me) — I'll create the org and hand over one scoped API key for eval usage.
- VPC peering runbook & acceptance: Marissa Cole — she'll coordinate the peering config and test handshake.
- IP allowlist and test verification: Evelyn Hart — will run tokenized request checks and share logs.

We can hit the provisioning milestone on 2027-04-06 for the test org and initial API key. Marissa, can you confirm peering doc ETA (we should include expected CIDR format and security group notes)?

Alex — two notes for your infra team to prepare:
1) Redwood accepts peering from single /16 or split /24 blocks; we'll need the exact ranges you plan to peer.
2) For allowlist validation we will supply three IPs from our egress NATs for you to add. Those will be listed in vpc-peering-cidr-list.txt after Marissa completes the runbook.

I'll attach a template API key rotation / scope doc (redwood-api-key-template.txt) and include it in the MAP workbook.

Next step: I'll provision the org tonight and send the API key + onboarding checklist by Wed morning (4/06).

Thanks — Rachel
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-api-key-template.txt (text/plain)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@cloudclinic.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — peering checklist and timeline

Alex / Rachel — looping in a short checklist and timeline for the peering work so CloudClinic's network team can prep endpoints. High level:

Peering checklist (Redwood-run):
- Confirm CloudClinic CIDR ranges (we need exact prefixes)
- Create peering request in console and capture request ID
- Exchange routing table entries and agree on advertised prefixes
- Run handshake test (ping & BGP route validation where applicable)
- Schedule final acceptance test with Evelyn for API allowlist validation

Timeline proposal:
- 4/02: CloudClinic shares CIDRs + service account contact (you said EOD 4/02)
- 4/06: Redwood provisions test org + issues API key (as Rachel noted)
- 4/07-4/09: Peering configuration and handshake tests (subject to your change window)
- 4/12: Acceptance tests (API calls from CloudClinic to Redwood sandbox endpoints)
- 4/14: Sign-off / MAP close if acceptance passes

If any of these dates are tight, we can compress by doing parallel validation but would need your infra to commit to same-day responses during the 4/07-4/09 window.

Rishi — I'll need your help if we encounter route propagation differences (BGP) during the handshake.

Alex — will you confirm whether CloudClinic expects a maintenance window for the handshake? If yes, propose a 2-hour block on 4/08 afternoon and we'll reserve Marissa + Rishi.

— Marissa
Principal Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vpc-peering-cidr-list.txt (text/plain)]

From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@cloudclinic.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudclinic.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — peering checklist and timeline

Thanks all — this looks good. Quick confirmations from CloudClinic side:
- CIDRs attached (see below) — team will be on standby for same-day responses during 4/07-4/09.
- No full maintenance window needed; handshake traffic will be limited to test prefixes and low-volume BGP sessions. We'll still block 4/08 14:00-16:00 PT as contingency.

CIDRs: 10.200.0.0/16, 10.201.0.0/16
Service account: infra-ops@cloudclinic.com (SAML-backed)

Next steps: Rachel, when you send over the test org + API key please include the scoped usage limits (tokens/min) so we can configure load tests for acceptance. Once we finish the acceptance tests we'll move to the MAP sign-off on 4/14.

Appreciate the clarity — Alex
Engineering Lead, CloudClinic
